gbm_population_evidence.quote: each MMPH session will include Gentle Body Movement (GBM,10-min), Restorative Pose (Pose,10-min), and Body Awareness Meditation (BAM, 20-min).

candidate_evidence.quote: Mindfulness Meditation for Pulmonary Hypertension (MMPH) (other names: MMPH intervention): Eight weeks of Mindfulness Meditation practice for patients with Pulmonary Hypertension condition.

coder_notes: Behavioural mindfulness trial in pulmonary hypertension; 'GBM' here means Gentle Body Movement, not glioblastoma. No drug interventions. Phase NA. Treatment setting not applicable to a non-cancer trial, coded unclear.
